content: Hello Guys, my name is Sahin and I am currently in my last semester of my masters in mathematics in Germany and I wanted to try writing my thesis or parts of it in lean (depending on what is more possible for me). Concretely, my Thesis is in the area of Yang mills and index estimates, so I wanted to ask if there are helpful libraries that I am not aware of or any guides on how to work with a Lean project from ground up. I have never before done a Lean project, so I would be thankful for any tips or comments regarding this.
